lesson.titleZh: 不容質疑的人或事物／不可批評的制度

examples.en: The old rule is a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 舊規則是不容質疑的制度。

examples.en: The manager was a sacred cow in his former company.
examples.zh: 那名經理在前公司是一個沒有人敢批評的人物。

meaning.en: A person, belief, custom, rule, system, organisation or institution that people treat as too important to question, criticise or change, often without a good reason.
meaning.zh: 某個人物、信念、習俗、規則、制度、組織或機構受到過分保護，以致人們不敢質疑、批評或改變它，而且這種特殊待遇往往缺乏合理理由。
naturalZh: 被視為神聖不可侵犯的觀念
受到過分保護的人物或做法

register.summaryEn: workplace discussions; public speeches; opinion writing; political and social commentary; discussions about schools, companies and organisations.
register.summaryZh: 這個表達屬於較口語至中性的用語，而且明顯帶有批評意味。
contextsEn: discussions about schools, companies and organisations
contextsZh: 有關學校、公司和組織的討論。
register.formalEn: In a highly formal report, a more direct expression may sometimes be clearer:
register.formalZh: 在非常正式的報告中，直接說明問題有時會更加清楚。 只有當作者有意表達批評，而不只是陳述中立事實時，這個慣用語才特別合適。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.form: Subject + am / is / are / was / were + a sacred cow.
forms.example: The old rule is a sacred cow.

forms.form: Subject + become / becomes / became / has become + a sacred cow.
forms.example: The old system has become a sacred cow.

forms.form: Subject + be + treated / regarded / seen / viewed / considered + as + a sacred cow.
forms.example: The old policy is treated as a sacred cow.

forms.form: Subject + treat / regard / see / view + object + as + a sacred cow.
forms.example: Staff treat the Monday meeting as a sacred cow.

forms.form: Subject + make / makes / made / has made + object + a sacred cow.
forms.example: The manager made his favourite plan a sacred cow.
Some writers call the programme a sacred cow.
The old logo is the company’s sacred cow.

forms.form: Subject + challenge / question / criticise / protect + a sacred cow or sacred cows.
forms.example: We should challenge this sacred cow.
Sacred cows can prevent honest discussion.

forms.form: There + be + no / several / too many + sacred cows.
forms.example: There are no sacred cows in this classroom.

forms.form: Noun phrase + , + a sacred cow + , + rest of sentence.
forms.example: The old rule, a sacred cow for years, may finally be changed.

forms.form: Is + subject + really + a sacred cow?
forms.example: Is the coach’s plan really a sacred cow?
The old programme has been given sacred-cow status.

forms.form: By + V-ing is not part of the fixed expression.
forms.example: The manager made the old plan a sacred cow.

specificForms.titleZh: 句式一：主語 + be + a sacred cow
specificForms.formula: Subject + am / is / are / was / were + a sacred cow.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This is the most direct identifying pattern, but it is only one of several natural grammar shells.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這是最直接的識別句式，但只是多種自然句法框架的其中一種。

examples.en: The old rule is a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 舊規則是不容質疑的制度。

examples.en: The manager was a sacred cow in his former company.
examples.zh: 那名經理在前公司是一個沒有人敢批評的人物。

specificForms.titleEn: Become or Remain + a Sacred Cow
specificForms.formula: Subject + become / becomes / became / has become + a sacred cow.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The rule should not remain a sacred cow.
specificForms.descriptionZh: become 或 remain + a sacred cow 這項規則不應繼續成為不可質疑的制度。

examples.en: The old system has become a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 舊制度已成為不容質疑的制度。

examples.en: The annual event remains a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 每年的活動仍然不容質疑。

examples.en: The tradition may become a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 這項傳統可能會成為不容質疑的慣例。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式三：被動式 be treated as
specificForms.formula: Subject + be + treated / regarded / seen / viewed / considered + as + a sacred cow.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Subject + be + treated / regarded / seen / viewed / considered + as + a sacred cow.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Subject + be + treated / regarded / seen / viewed / considered + as + a sacred cow。

examples.en: The old policy is treated as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 舊政策被視為不可質疑的制度。

examples.en: The famous player was regarded as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 那名著名球員被視為不可批評的人物。

examples.en: The programme has long been viewed as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 該計劃長期被視為不容質疑的制度。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式四：主動式 treat something as
specificForms.formula: Subject + treat / regard / see / view + object + as + a sacred cow.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The person who gives the special protection becomes the subject. The protected person or thing becomes the object.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 給予特殊保護的人或群體成為主語； 受到保護的人或事物則成為賓語。

examples.en: Staff treat the Monday meeting as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 員工把星期一例會視為不可質疑的慣例。

examples.en: The team regards its star player as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 球隊把明星球員視為不可批評的人物。

examples.en: Many people see the old tradition as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 許多人把舊傳統視為不容挑戰的習俗。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式五：make + 賓語 + a sacred cow
specificForms.formula: Subject + make / makes / made / has made + object + a sacred cow.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This pattern focuses on the action or situation that gives something protected status.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式着重說明某個行動或情況如何令一件事物獲得特殊保護。

examples.en: The manager made his favourite plan a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 經理令自己最喜愛的計劃變成不容質疑的計劃。

examples.en: The founder’s support has made the old logo a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 創辦人的支持令舊標誌變成不容批評的事物。

specificForms.titleEn: Call or Describe Something a Sacred Cow
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Call + Object + a Sacred Cow.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Call + Object + a Sacred Cow。

examples.en: Some writers call the programme a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 有些作者把該計劃稱為不容質疑的制度。

examples.en: The journalist described the parade as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 記者把巡遊形容為不容質疑的傳統。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式七：所有格及 of 結構
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: X + be + possessive + sacred cow.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：X + be + possessive + sacred cow。

examples.en: The old logo is the company’s sacred cow.
examples.zh: 舊標誌是公司不容批評的事物。

examples.en: The homework rule is one of the school’s sacred cows.
examples.zh: 功課規定是學校其中一項不容質疑的制度。

examples.en: Speed has become the sacred cow of that department.
examples.zh: 速度已成為該部門不容質疑的原則。

specificForms.titleEn: Sacred Cow as the Object of Another Verb
specificForms.titleZh: 句式八：作為另一動詞的賓語
specificForms.formula: Subject + challenge / question / criticise / protect + a sacred cow or sacred cows.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The target is a noun phrase. It does not always need to follow a linking verb.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 目標表達是一個名詞短語，不一定要放在連繫動詞後面。

examples.en: We should challenge this sacred cow.
examples.zh: 我們應該挑戰這項不容質疑的制度。

examples.en: The committee questioned one of the school’s sacred cows.
examples.zh: 委員會質疑學校其中一項不容質疑的規定。

examples.en: The company continues to protect its sacred cows.
examples.zh: 公司繼續保護其不容批評的做法。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式九：sacred cows 作主語
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Sacred cows + verb.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Sacred cows + verb。

examples.en: Sacred cows can prevent honest discussion.
examples.zh: 不容質疑的觀念可能妨礙坦誠討論。

examples.en: Sacred cows should still be questioned.
examples.zh: 即使是不容質疑的觀念，也應受到質疑。

examples.en: No sacred cow should be protected from fair criticism.
examples.zh: 任何所謂不可質疑的人或事物，都不應逃避合理批評。

specificForms.formula: There + be + no / several / too many + sacred cows.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: There + be + no / several / too many + sacred cows.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：There + be + no / several / too many + sacred cows。

examples.en: There are no sacred cows in this classroom.
examples.zh: 這個課室裏沒有任何不容質疑的規則或做法。

examples.en: There may be several sacred cows in the organisation.
examples.zh: 該組織可能有幾項不容質疑的做法。

examples.en: There should not be any sacred cows in an honest review.
examples.zh: 坦誠的檢討中不應有任何不容質疑的事物。

specificForms.formula: Noun phrase + , + a sacred cow + , + rest of sentence.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This structure allows the idiom to add a short description without always occupying the final position.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式讓慣用語作為簡短補充說明，不必每次都放在句末。

examples.en: The old rule, a sacred cow for years, may finally be changed.
examples.zh: 這項多年來不容質疑的舊規則，現在可能終於會作出改動。

examples.en: The food ban—a sacred cow for years—may finally be reviewed.
examples.zh: 禁帶食物的規定多年來一直不容質疑，現在可能終於會受到檢討。

specificForms.formula: Is + subject + really + a sacred cow?
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Is + subject + really + a sacred cow?.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Is + subject + really + a sacred cow?。

examples.en: Is the coach’s plan really a sacred cow?
examples.zh: 教練的計劃真的不容質疑嗎？

examples.en: Why has the old website design become a sacred cow?
examples.zh: 為甚麼舊有的網站設計已變成不容質疑的安排？

examples.en: Which of these rules is treated as a sacred cow?
examples.zh: 這些規則中，哪一項被視為不可質疑？

specificForms.descriptionEn: The hyphen shows that sacred and cow work together to modify status.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 連字號表示 sacred 和 cow 共同修飾 status。

examples.en: The old programme has been given sacred-cow status.
examples.zh: 舊計劃被賦予了不可質疑的地位。

specificForms.titleZh: 句式十四：可選的 by + V-ing 延伸
specificForms.formula: By + V-ing is not part of the fixed expression.
specificForms.descriptionEn: How did the manager give the plan its protected status?

examples.en: The manager made the old plan a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 經理令舊計劃變成不容質疑的計劃。

examples.en: The manager made the old plan a sacred cow by linking it closely to the founder’s name.
examples.zh: 經理把舊計劃與創辦人的名字緊密連繫起來，使它變成不容質疑的計劃。

benefits.titleZh: 簡潔指出不合理的特殊保護
benefits.en: The idiom compresses the longer explanation into one noun phrase.
benefits.zh: 這項規則已成為學校不容質疑的制度。 這個慣用語把較長的解釋濃縮成一個名詞短語。

examples.en: The rule has become a sacred cow at the school.
examples.zh: 這項規則已成為學校不容質疑的制度。

benefits.en: The old system is respected. The second sentence suggests that the respect has become excessive.
benefits.zh: 舊制度受到尊重。 舊制度被視為不容質疑的制度。 第二句表示這種尊重已變得過分。

examples.en: The old system is treated as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 舊制度被視為不容質疑的制度。

benefits.titleEn: It Is Useful When Calling for Change
benefits.en: The expression helps the speaker argue that every rule, custom or policy should remain open to review.
benefits.zh: 任何校規都不應成為不可質疑的制度。 這個表達有助說話者主張每項規則、習俗或政策都應接受檢討。

examples.en: No school rule should be a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 任何校規都不應成為不可質疑的制度。

benefits.titleEn: It Works in Both Singular and Plural Forms
benefits.titleZh: 可靈活使用單數及複數
benefits.en: This allows the speaker to discuss one protected item or a wider culture of avoiding criticism.
benefits.zh: 舊標誌是不容批評的事物。 公司有幾項不容質疑的做法。 說話者可以用它描述一項受到保護的事物，或一種普遍逃避批評的文化。

examples.en: The old logo is a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 舊標誌是不容批評的事物。

examples.en: The company has several sacred cows.
examples.zh: 公司有幾項不容質疑的做法。

benefits.en: a subject complement; an object complement; the object of a verb; the subject of a sentence; part of a possessive phrase; an appositive noun phrase; a plural noun phrase; a compound modifier.

benefits.titleEn: It Helps Learners Understand Commentary and Debate
benefits.titleZh: 有助理解評論及辯論語言
benefits.en: old rules; powerful people; protected institutions; long-standing beliefs; traditions that resist change; plans that leaders refuse to review. The idiom is useful, but it is not automatically better than a plain explanation. Use it only when the context genuinely involves excessive protection from criticism or change. Model Examples Nobody at the school dares to question the old uniform rule. The company protects its old logo from all criticism. The director says that every tradition and practice may be questioned.
benefits.zh: 學生理解這個慣用語後，便更容易理解有關舊規則、有權勢人物、受保護機構、長期信念及抗拒改變的傳統的評論。 這個慣用語十分實用，但不一定比直接解釋更好。 只有當語境真正涉及過分保護、不容批評或拒絕改變時，才應使用。 學校裏沒有人敢質疑舊有的校服規定。 學校把舊有的校服規定視為不可質疑的制度。 公司不容任何人批評舊標誌。 公司把舊標誌視為不可批評的事物。 總監表示，每項傳統和做法都可以受到質疑。 總監表示，不應有任何不容質疑的傳統或做法。

examples.en: The old uniform rule is a sacred cow at the school.
examples.zh: 學校把舊有的校服規定視為不可質疑的制度。

examples.en: The company treats its old logo as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 公司把舊標誌視為不可批評的事物。

examples.en: The director says that there should be no sacred cows.
examples.zh: 總監表示，不應有任何不容質疑的傳統或做法。

origin.statusEn: Well-Documented Allusion; Exact First Speaker Unknown
origin.statusZh: 典故來源有較充分記錄；確切首次說話者不明

history.en: Merriam-Webster dates its first known figurative use to 1910 and explains the phrase as coming from the veneration of cows by Hindus. Collins gives a similar dating of approximately 1905–1910 and also connects the expression with the traditional protected status of cattle in Hinduism. These dates refer to early documented English uses; they do not prove that one identifiable person invented the expression at that exact moment.
history.zh: Merriam-Webster 把目前已知的早期比喻用法定於1910年，並指出這個短語與印度教徒對牛的尊崇有關。 Collins 提供相近的1905至1910年時期，並同樣把這個表達與印度教傳統中牛受到保護的地位連繫起來。 這些年份只代表目前找到的早期英語書面記錄，並不能證明某一個人在該年確切創造了這個表達。

history.en: English speakers transferred the image of a specially protected animal to people, beliefs, customs and institutions. A person or idea that nobody dared to attack, question or change could therefore be described figuratively as a sacred cow.
history.zh: 英語使用者把受到特殊保護的動物這個意象，引申到人物、信念、習俗和機構之上。 因此，若沒有人敢批評、質疑或改變某個人物或觀念，便可以把它比喻為 a sacred cow。

origin.memoryEn: A literally protected cow becomes the image of an idea or institution that people are afraid to touch, question or criticise.
origin.memoryZh: 一隻受到特殊保護的牛，成為一個比喻畫面，用來代表人們不敢觸碰、質疑或批評的觀念或機構。

rules.titleZh: 規則一：sacred cow 必須連在一起
rules.zh: sacred cow 必須連在一起

rules.titleEn: Use “A” Only with a Singular Indefinite Form
rules.titleZh: 規則二：a 只用於單數不定形式
rules.en: Use “A” Only with a Singular Indefinite Form
rules.zh: a 只用於單數不定形式

rules.titleEn: Use the Plural When Referring to Several Items
rules.titleZh: 規則三：多於一項時使用複數
rules.en: Use the Plural When Referring to Several Items
rules.zh: 該組織有幾項不容質疑的做法。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Automatically Keep the Article “A”
rules.titleZh: 規則四：不要在所有句式中機械地保留 a
rules.en: The common form a sacred cow is not the only grammatical form.
rules.zh: 常見形式 a sacred cow 並不是唯一正確形式。

rules.titleZh: 規則五：這個表達通常帶有批評意味
rules.en: He is respected by everyone. This suggests that the protection is excessive or unfair.
rules.zh: 所有人都尊重他。 他被視為不可批評的人物。 第二句表示說話者認為這種保護過分或不公平。

examples.en: He is treated as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 他被視為不可批評的人物。

rules.titleZh: 規則六：受到尊重並不足夠
rules.en: Everyone respects the teacher because she works hard. Nothing suggests that people are afraid to question or criticise her. Everyone is afraid to criticise the teacher, even when she makes a mistake.
rules.zh: 大家都尊重那名老師，因為她工作努力。 句子並沒有表示人們不敢質疑或批評她。 即使那名老師犯錯，所有人仍不敢批評她。 那名老師被視為不可批評的人物。

examples.en: The teacher is treated as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 那名老師被視為不可批評的人物。

rules.titleZh: 規則七：歷史悠久並不足夠
rules.en: The festival is one hundred years old. The festival is one hundred years old, and nobody is willing to discuss changing it.
rules.zh: 這個節慶活動已有一百年歷史。 這個節慶活動已有一百年歷史，而且沒有人願意討論作出改動。 這個節慶活動已成為不容改動的傳統。

examples.en: The festival has become a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 這個節慶活動已成為不容改動的傳統。

rules.titleEn: Identify Who or What Receives Protection
rules.titleZh: 規則八：清楚指出誰或甚麼受到保護
rules.en: The second sentence may be natural when the earlier context is clear, but a standalone answer key should identify the protected person, rule, idea or institution.
rules.zh: 公司把舊標誌視為不可批評的事物。 第二句在已有清楚上文時可以自然使用，但獨立的參考答案應清楚指出受到保護的人物、規則、 想法或機構。

examples.en: The company treats its old logo as a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 公司把舊標誌視為不可批評的事物。

rules.en: The source describes a developing situation, not an established fact.
rules.zh: 這個計劃可能正逐漸成為不容質疑的計劃。 這個計劃是不容質疑的計劃。 原句描述的是正在形成的情況，而不是已確立的事實。

examples.en: The plan may be turning into a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 這個計劃可能正逐漸成為不容質疑的計劃。

examples.en: The plan is a sacred cow.
examples.zh: 這個計劃是不容質疑的計劃。

rules.en: Do not change the time merely to create variety.
rules.zh: 不要只是為了製造變化而改變原句的時間。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Repeat the Meaning Unnecessarily
rules.titleZh: 規則十一：不要不必要地重複意思
rules.en: The final clause simply explains the idiom again. The idiom itself carries the protected-from-criticism meaning.
rules.zh: 句末部分只是再次解釋慣用語的意思。 這項規則是學校不容質疑的制度。 慣用語本身已經包含「不容批評或質疑」的意思。

examples.en: The rule is a sacred cow at the school.
examples.zh: 這項規則是學校不容質疑的制度。

rules.titleZh: 規則十二：避免逐字翻譯
rules.en: Do not translate the idiom as: In figurative contexts, translate the intended meaning:
rules.zh: 一隻神聖的牛不容質疑的制度； 不可批評的人物； 不容改動的傳統； 受到過分保護的觀念

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse It with “Holy Cow”
rules.titleZh: 規則十三：不要與 holy cow 混淆
rules.en: A person, belief or institution protected from criticism. An expression of surprise. They are not interchangeable.
rules.zh: 不容批評的人物、信念或機構。 表達驚訝的感嘆語。 兩者不能互換。

rules.titleZh: 規則十四：尊重地理解歷史意象

questions.prompt: A: Every meeting must still be held in person, but nobody can explain why. B: The committee should question that rule.
questions.promptZh: 甲：每次會議仍必須親身舉行，但沒有人能解釋原因。 乙：委員會應該質疑這項規定。
questions.answer: The rule that every meeting must be held in person is one sacred cow the committee should question.
questions.answerZh: 每次會議都必須親身舉行的規定，是委員會應該質疑的一項不可動搖的慣例。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, belief, custom, rule, system, organisation or institution that people treat as too important to question, criticise or change, often without a good reason.

questions.prompt: Some workers worry that the presenter’s opinions are slowly becoming impossible to criticise.
questions.promptZh: 有些員工擔心，主持人的意見正逐漸變得不容批評。
questions.answer: The presenter’s opinions may be becoming sacred cows at the station.
questions.answerZh: 主持人的意見可能正逐漸成為電台裏不容批評的看法。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, belief, custom, rule, system, organisation or institution that people treat as too important to question, criticise or change, often without a good reason.

questions.prompt: A: How can the company encourage honest discussion? B: Every plan, including the manager’s plan, must be open to criticism.
questions.promptZh: 甲：公司可以如何鼓勵坦誠討論？ 乙：每個計劃，包括經理的計劃，都必須接受批評。
questions.answer: If the company wants honest discussion, there can be no sacred cows.
questions.answerZh: 如果公司希望有坦誠的討論，便不能有任何不容質疑的計劃。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, belief, custom, rule, system, organisation or institution that people treat as too important to question, criticise or change, often without a good reason.

questions.prompt: A new worker asked why the old poster had never been changed. Everyone in the room suddenly became silent.
questions.promptZh: 一名新員工問為甚麼舊海報從未更換。房內所有人突然沉默下來。
questions.answer: The silence told her that the old poster was a sacred cow in the office.
questions.answerZh: 眾人的沉默令她明白，那張舊海報是辦公室裏不容質疑的事物。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, belief, custom, rule, system, organisation or institution that people treat as too important to question, criticise or change, often without a good reason.

questions.prompt: The director said that the famous actor was not protected from fair criticism.
questions.promptZh: 總監表示，那名著名演員並非不受合理批評。
questions.answer: The director denied that the famous actor was a sacred cow at the theatre.
questions.answerZh: 總監否認那名著名演員是劇院裏不可批評的人物。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, belief, custom, rule, system, organisation or institution that people treat as too important to question, criticise or change, often without a good reason.

questions.prompt: A tradition can be respected without being placed beyond all criticism.
questions.promptZh: 我們可以尊重傳統，而不必令它完全不受批評。
questions.answer: A respected tradition does not have to become a sacred cow.
questions.answerZh: 受人尊重的傳統不必成為不容質疑的事物。
questions.targetMeaning: A person, belief, custom, rule, system, organisation or institution that people treat as too important to question, criticise or change, often without a good reason.

questions.prompt: Every other department reviewed its old habits. The finance team alone refused to discuss replacing its paper forms.
questions.promptZh: 其他所有部門都檢討了舊有習慣，唯獨財務團隊拒絕討論取代紙本表格。
questions.answer: Although every other department reviewed its old habits, paper forms remained the finance team’s last sacred cow.
questions.answerZh: 雖然其他所有部門都檢討了舊有習慣，但紙本表格仍是財務團隊最後一項不容質疑的做法。
